slides.texte_overlay:
Man to man, this is how
you get back up after
your worst year

1. Write down what went wrong
Once. Every part of it.
Then close the notebook.

2. Tell one person the truth
Not everyone.
One man you trust.

3. Feed your head
One new idea a day.
A mind with something to
chew on stops chewing on you.
slides.texte_sophia:
3. Feed your head
One lesson a day on the Sophia app.
A mind with something to
chew on stops chewing on you.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. Cook your own meals
For one month.
Small discipline,
big signal to yourself.

5. Do one thing that scares you
A trip, a call, a class.
Courage comes back with use.

6. Help someone else
Nothing gets you out of
your own head faster.
